cta.trial: Start Your Clinic Free for 7 Days

hero.title: Run the whole clinic from one calm screen.
hero.lead: Dental Nova is built for dentists who want the patient file, the chart, the chair, and the calendar in one place — not five apps.
hero.caption: A complete clinic system. Desktop and phone.

value.title: Everything the doctor touches, in one product.
value.text: Open a patient and the chart, treatments, account, files, and next visit are already there. The software stays out of the way so the clinic can move.

clinical.title: The patient file is the clinic.
clinical.text: Treatments sit on the tooth. Notes, files, and the account stay with the same record. No jumping between screens to finish a visit.

agenda.title: A calendar that knows the chair.
agenda.text: Week and month views, 15 or 30 minute slots, and a dedicated Emergency list you can drag onto the day.

ai.title: Ask the clinic. Get an answer.
ai.text: The assistant reads the clinic language — patients, plans, and daily work — in Arabic and English.
ai.a: Two patients after 11:00. One crown, one follow-up.

wa.title: Reminders that patients actually open.
wa.text: Send appointment and follow-up messages from the same record. Review the text, then send.
wa.previewText: Your visit is tomorrow at 10:00. Reply if you need to move it.

mobile.title: The clinic in your pocket. Not a slimmed-down copy.
mobile.text: Open the same Dental Nova on your phone: the day, the patient, the chart, treatment, and the AI assistant.

editions.title: Offline on the clinic PC. Online when you need the clinic from anywhere.
editions.offlineText: Works on the clinic computer even without internet.
editions.onlineText: Reach the clinic over the internet — desk and phone.
editions.trialNote: 7-day free trial. Starts when DibNova activates the clinic.

final.title: Put the clinic on Dental Nova.
final.text: Start a 7-day trial, or sign in if your clinic is already live.
